checks.detail: Each required heading must appear on its intended page.
Cover identifies the product, decision, readiness, and next action.
Executive summary uses the required business memo structure.
Report follows decision, evidence, insight, direction, plan, risk, and source flow.
Insights and plan pages translate evidence into named actions.
Every major score has a nearby business implication.
Concept page connects packaging to strategy and labels the visual as directional.
Technical identifiers appear in the appendix and not the commercial body.
Forbidden generic interpretation phrases are absent.
Repeated caveats: treat preference and purchase-intent findings as directional until a broader panel is collected. | final packaging requires design, claims, and legal approval.

weaknesses: Every major score has a nearby business implication.
